coverage: Austria plus selected nearby Central European stations; this bootstrap catalog is not global.

provider.name: Climate.OneBuilding
provider.citation: Lawrie, Linda K.; Crawley, Drury B. 2026. Development of Global Typical Meteorological Years (TMYx). Climate.OneBuilding.Org (paper in progress).

distribution_policy.bundled_content: Normalized station metadata and provider download URLs only.
distribution_policy.note: Building Energy Tools does not assert a blanket redistribution license for upstream climate files. EPW payloads are fetched on demand from the provider and are not committed to this repository. Dataset-specific source and citation information remains the responsibility of the upstream provider/source dataset.

maintenance.promotion_model: Generate candidate catalog and manifest, validate them, review the diff, then merge through a normal pull request.
